auth.raw_authorization_summary: Authorization For Individuals and Businesses, use OAuth 2.0 server or user token with the order.write scope. For Third-Party Aggregators, use OAuth 2.0 user token with the order.write scope.

response.content_type: JSON; exact success header requires sandbox verification

constraints: Body is an array of order objects. Local default: one order per submission to simplify reconciliation; provider maximum batch size is not specified.
Each order has at most 99 lines; purchaseOrder is at most 16 characters. Preserve the full local PO separately; do not silently truncate.
deliveryAppointment is optional, but all four documented child fields are required when supplied; instructions max 255 characters.
Appointment codes: AT, AM, PM, FS, ST, TR. Use HH:mm local times; fromTime applies to ST/TR, toTime to TR; other unused values are 00:00.
Only typeCode SO is supported for placement. Delivery service examples: COM, CPU, EXP, OTR, OTG, OTW, TPC; verify branch support.
shipTo.number is the purchasing job account; shipTo.name/address/contacts describe this order delivery. Do not equate the account address with the delivery address.
Include line dimensions.length only for dimensional items, and require a valid returned variation for those items.
Use ABC-provided itemDescription. orderedQty and unitPrice each carry their own uom; do not assume these UOMs are identical.
unitPrice.instructions must be present; empty string is allowed. Address line2/line3 are marked required in the table; empty strings occur in examples.
API receipt is not branch acceptance, delivery confirmation, or final price acceptance. Check every orders[] result and counters, including on 202.

Custom/unknown item numbers can be accepted for branch review according to the overview. This is an exception workflow, not a normal validated/catalog-priced purchase; preserve user intent and obtain branch pricing rather than guessing an item. The overview description field wording differs from the endpoint itemDescription field; confirm the custom-item payload.

request.recievedTime | request.receivedTime -> submission.providerReceivedAtRaw
orders[].requestId -> local order-request ledger join
orders[].confirmationNumber -> submitted order receipt; keep null when failure
orders[].message plus request.ordersFailed/ordersSucceded -> per-order result; HTTP 202 alone is insufficient

documentation_issues.disposition: Draft validator uses the example array and Ship-To spelling; verify accepted values and case.

documentation_issues.finding: lines[].currency.symbol is typed float in the table but is a string in the example.
documentation_issues.disposition: Preserve raw field; example-derived shape uses string. Do not cast a currency symbol to a number.

documentation_issues.finding: Registration permits ORDER_UPDATE and ORDER_INVOICED, but PATCH says only ORDER_UPDATE is supported.
documentation_issues.disposition: Only propose ORDER_UPDATE patches until invoice-event PATCH support is verified. Do not silently remove an existing invoice subscription.

documentation_issues.finding: Register Webhook places the invoice secret in webhookDetails[].apiKey; the invoice event Authorization section says it appears in the Authorization header.
documentation_issues.disposition: Block trusted invoice-event processing until the accepted location and exact value format are confirmed. Do not accept an OR of both possibilities as a substitute for verification.

documentation_issues.finding: Operation pages list order.read for individual business reads; the individual-business client-credentials grant lists allOrder.read.
documentation_issues.disposition: Record the provider-approved scope profile per integration; confirm allOrder.read versus order.read per read endpoint.

documentation_issues.finding: The list table types templateId as integer but its example uses string; the detail table types it as string but its example uses number.
documentation_issues.disposition: Normalize IDs to internal strings without modifying the raw response; verify wire path representation.

documentation_issues.finding: Several table entries disagree with examples, including familyid/familyId, familyName/supplierName types, and nested item/UOM paths.
documentation_issues.disposition: Keep table declarations and example-derived shapes separately; do not generate strict response validation directly from the table.

documentation_issues.finding: The table calls billTo an array and postal an object; its example uses a billTo object and a postal string.
documentation_issues.disposition: Use a permissive raw response boundary and a versioned normalized mapping verified with fixtures.

documentation_issues.finding: The list example is not complete JSON. Responses use event as a string, while register and patch use events as an array; the list example includes ORDER_STATUS.
documentation_issues.disposition: Treat request events and response event as distinct fields; do not offer ORDER_STATUS as a supported registration event without confirmation.

documentation_issues.finding: The Place Orders 403 description mentions order.read, while its Authorization section requires order.write.
documentation_issues.disposition: Use order.write as the documented placement scope; retain the status-text discrepancy.

documentation_issues.finding: The status table labels code 200 Bad Request and 400 Object Not Found despite contradictory descriptions.
documentation_issues.disposition: Use numeric status plus validated payload. An empty branches array is documented as no offered branch within the accessible set.

documentation_issues.finding: The event page includes a generic response-code table, but does not define receiver acknowledgment deadlines, retries, replay, ordering, or event IDs.
documentation_issues.disposition: Do not present that table as a webhook delivery guarantee. Establish receiver and replay behavior with ABC.

documentation_issues.finding: The overview says Sold-To is not used for API requests, while Get Sold-To explicitly requires a soldToNumber.
documentation_issues.disposition: Interpret the overview statement in the purchasing workflow context; retain the documented Sold-To retrieval endpoint.

documentation_issues.finding: Some samples contain comments, trailing commas, incomplete arrays, singular partner hostnames, or inconsistent embed syntax.
documentation_issues.disposition: Generate valid JSON and use configured partners hosts. Verify embed encoding by endpoint. Samples are evidence, not executable fixtures.

documentation_issues.finding: Many tables do not identify required parameters, even when examples contain them.
documentation_issues.disposition: Mark upstream requiredness unspecified. Any stricter internal requirement is an explicit local design choice.

documentation_issues.finding: No transaction rollback, requestId deduplication guarantee, webhook HMAC signature, ordering guarantee, pricing expiry, or API latency SLA was established in the reviewed pages.
documentation_issues.disposition: Do not promise these properties. Implement local controls and obtain provider confirmation where needed.

documentation_issues.finding: The overview describes custom item numbers such as CUSTOM with item details in description, while Place Orders names itemDescription. These orders bypass normal exact-catalog/price validation.
documentation_issues.disposition: Keep the standard automated order flow on verified catalog lines. Confirm custom-item request fields with ABC and support a separate explicitly reviewed exception path.
